channel.title: Orchard Blog
channel.description: Notes on decentralized mesh networks, offline super-libraries, mutual aid, and Fediverse protocols from the Orchard team.

item.title: Building Resilience: Why Offline-First Software is the Future of Human Knowledge
item.description: When internet connectivity cuts out, access to critical medical guides, encyclopedias, and educational courses shouldn't vanish. Here is how Orchard stores human knowledge on-device.
item.author: noreply@orchard-website.lovable.app (Elena Rostova)

item.title: How LoRa and Bluetooth Mesh Keep Communities Connected When the Grid Goes Down
item.description: Cell towers fail. Decentralized peer-to-peer radio meshes don't. Learn how Orchard combines Signal Double Ratchet encryption with packet radio and BLE.
item.author: noreply@orchard-website.lovable.app (Tariq Vance)

item.title: Unifying the Fediverse: Mastodon, Bluesky, Lemmy, and Nostr in One Stream
item.description: Stop fragmenting your social experience across incompatible silos. Orchard unifies decentralized protocols into 16 categorized, chronological channels.
item.author: noreply@orchard-website.lovable.app (Siddharth Nair)

item.title: The 21-Category Local Exchange: Mapping Food Forests and Mutual Aid Networks
item.description: True community security starts with knowing where local provisions, clean water, seed banks, and tool libraries exist. Here's how Orchard's 3D connection map works offline.
item.author: noreply@orchard-website.lovable.app (Elena Rostova)
